title: 心理科学専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Psychological Science Major Lab/Exercises A
educationalGoal: In the “Questionnaire Method and Survey Practice” component, students will learn a series of processes from questionnaire preparation to surveys and analysis in psychological survey methods. In the “Observation Method and Elderly Simulation” component, students will practice data collection and analysis in observation methods (including statistical analysis using nonparametric tests) through the experience of elderly simulation.
advice: Of the major research methods in psychology, this course will focus on questionnaire methods and observation methods. As a comprehensive task of learning results so far, students will conduct complete a research study using these methods. Students form a team, determine the purpose of the survey and the behavior to be observed, set the survey items and performance tasks, collect and analyze the data, make a presentation for each team, and discuss the research results. In addition, each individual student will write a research paper summarizing the entire study. In the “Questionnaire Method and Survey Practical Training” component, students will learn a series of processes from data collection to analysis, starting with selection of question items, with the aim of acquiring procedures and analysis methods for the questionnaire method. The “Observation Method and Elderly Simulation” component aims to teach the procedure and analysis method of the observation method and to help students understand the method of hypothesis generation type research. The main objective of observation is human behavior in elderly simulation. Students also practice qualitative data analysis methods obtained by observation methods and statistical analysis using nonparametric methods. This course requires students to bring a PC to every class. Strictly refrain from being late, taking unauthorized absences, and having an uncooperative attitude toward team activities.
requiredKnowledge: Fully understand basic information on learning, cognition and language learned from previous courses. Be sure to fully understand the basic operations of a PC, as it may be necessary to perform exercises using a PC.

activityGoals.body: Ability to pick out the question items necessary for the evaluation and creation of a questionnaire
Ability to sum up and analyze the data.
Ability to perform a statistical analysis of the data and consider the results.
Ability to understand a series of procedures in observation methods and collect data.
Ability to understand data analysis in observation methods, and actually analyze the data.
Ability to understand nonparametric methods and actually use them in data analysis.

achievementLevels.ideal: Ability to understand and practice a series of tasks from creating questionnaires, collecting data, and performing analysis according to the purpose. Ability to collect data by observation method and understand a series of analysis procedures including non-parametric methods.
